source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Fairly little nursing role in supporting mobility goals, since this is considered exclusively a therapy responsibility on the unit","B":"Individualized mobility support based on the specific level and completeness of injury, working toward the client's highest achievable level of functional independence","C":"Assuming that every client with a spinal cord injury shares essentially identical mobility potential and long-term recovery goals overall","D":"Discouraging the client from attempting any mobility whatsoever, out of concern for preventing any further injury from possibly occurring"}}
source_row.rationale: Nursing support for mobility in spinal cord injury involves individualized support based on the specific level and completeness of injury, working toward the client's highest achievable level of functional independence, in active collaboration with (not separate from) physical and occupational therapy.
source_row.source_name: Consortium for Spinal Cord Medicine — Mobility Goals in SCI
